title: Bowmaster — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 300/310/311/312/314/40003; WZ API for Fury of the Wild + HEXA cores)

skills.name: Critical Shot
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate.

skills.name: Archery Mastery
skills.description: Gain proficiency in the fundamentals of Archery. Increases Range, Movement Speed, Attack Speed and Max Movement Speed.

skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Allows you to use the Double Jump skill to move very quickly. Double-tap the up arrow key to jump again while in mid-air. Double-tap the down arrow key to descend more quickly.

skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Allows you to use the Double Jump skill to move very quickly. Double-tap the up arrow key to jump again while in mid-air. Double-tap the down arrow key to descend more quickly.

skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Allows you to use the Double Jump skill to move very quickly. Double-tap the up arrow key to jump again while in mid-air. Double-tap the down arrow key to descend more quickly.

skills.name: Arrow Blow
skills.description: Shoot consecutive arrows at multiple enemies.

skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Allows you to use the Double Jump skill to move very quickly. Double-tap the up arrow key to jump again while in mid-air. Double-tap the down arrow key to descend more quickly. If you use Action Customization, you can move up in the air with the up arrow and jump keys, and descend with the down arrow and jump keys.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.

skills.name: Bow Mastery
skills.description: Increases Bow Mastery.

skills.name: Final Attack : Bow
skills.description: Chance to deal an additional hit after landing a direct attack skill. Must have a bow equipped.

skills.name: Agile Bows
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Dexterity.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Quiver Cartridge
skills.description: Use a special arrowhead. Learning Enchanted Quiver adds arrowheads you can use. Arrowheads can be changed by using the skill again.

skills.name: Soul Arrow: Bow
skills.description: Allows you to use your bow without consuming arrows and increases Attack Power.\nThe arrows in your inventory with the highest Attack Power will be used to calculate your damage.

skills.name: Wind Arrow
skills.description: Fire multiple arrows that fly like the wind.

skills.name: Covering Fire
skills.description: Fire arrows while leaping backwards. While firing, you'll have 100% Knockback Resistance. If you press and hold the skill key, you will fire arrows rapidly while in mid-air. You will temporarily not be pushed back by any attack after casting.

skills.name: Quiver Cartridge
skills.description: Use a special arrowhead. Learning Enchanted Quiver adds arrowheads you can use. Arrowheads can be changed by using the skill again.

skills.name: Quiver Cartridge (Blood Arrow)
skills.description: Uses a Blood Arrow with a special arrowhead. Fires a Blood Arrow that has a set chance to restore in proportion to your Max HP.

skills.name: Quiver Cartridge (Magic Arrow)
skills.description: Uses a Magic Arrow with a special arrowhead. Fires a Magic Arrow that has a set chance to pursue and attack the enemy.

skills.name: Swift Surge
skills.description: Breaks through the enemy in front of you by charging with the bow held firmly before you.

skills.name: Mortal Blow
skills.description: If the attack hits a certain number of times, the damage increases and allows you to deal a more powerful attack.

skills.name: Evasion Boost
skills.description: Grants a chance to dodge enemy attacks. If you succeed, attacks you land in the next second will result in Critical Hits. Also increases Knockback Resistance and Max HP permanently.

skills.name: Focused Fury
skills.description: Constant attacks focus your concentration, increasing your Status Resistance. Getting an Abnormal Status while this buff is in effect will reset the increased Status Resistance. Also increases Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Marksmanship
skills.description: When attacking, ignore a portion of enemy Defense. Permanently increases your Attack Power.

skills.name: Reckless Hunt: Bow
skills.description: Reduces Defense and instead increases Attack Power and Final Damage.

skills.name: Phoenix
skills.description: Temporarily summon a Phoenix to deal Fire damage. Has a chance to Stun enemies as well.\nPermanently increases Defense. Ignores enemy damage reflection skills.

skills.name: Arrow Blaster
skills.description:
Shoot an arrow at a high angle. If you press and hold the skill key, you will fire continuously. While firing, press Up or Down to control the force of the shot.
While casting the skill, press the Interact/Harvest key to set up an Arrow Blaster--which fires arrows automatically--at your location. With Action Customization enabled, you can set up the Arrow Blaster by pressing the attack key, instead of the Interact/Harvest key.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.

skills.name: Speed Mirage
skills.description:
Fire arrows fast enough to leave afterimages.
After striking enemies with enough arrow-based attacks, creates afterimages that fires enemy-seeking arrows before vanishing. These arrows target a single enemy in front of the afterimage and damage any foes pierced on the way to the target. Arrow Blaster turret placement attacks don't count toward this skill's prerequisites.
Empowers Wind Arrow.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Speed Mirage
skills.description: Fire arrows fast enough to leave an afterimage.

skills.name: Blink Shot
skills.description: Mark the spot where you are currently standing. Use the skill again to ride a magic arrow back to that spot instantly. Use the skill again while holding the Down Arrow key to replace your original marker.

skills.name: Blink Shot
skills.description: Teleports you to the position you previously marked.

skills.name: Zephyr Shield
skills.description: Scatter enemy attacks to the winds.\nNot affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Bow Expert
skills.description: Increase Bow Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage. \nAdditionally, this skill allows you to set Arrow Blaster's firing angle instantly when placing. Placing while holding the Up Arrow key will fire at the highest angle, and placing while holding the Down Arrow key will fire at the lowest angle.

skills.name: Illusion Step
skills.description: Greatly increases your DEX and Avoidability, and reduces damage taken. Also increases Knockback Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack
skills.description: Permanently increases Attack Power. Greatly increases activation rate and damage of Final Attack.

skills.name: Quiver Cartridge
skills.description: Use a special arrowhead. Learning Enchanted Quiver adds arrowheads you can use. Arrowheads can be changed by using the skill again.

skills.name: Armor Break
skills.description: Pierce the enemy's defenses with the sharpness of a bowman that sees through the enemy's weakness and increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Speed Mirage II
skills.description: Your continued archery training has empowered your Speed Mirage.

skills.name: Enchanted Quiver
skills.description: Equips specialized arrowheads. You can switch between arrowheads by using the skill again. Also permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes - Persist
skills.description: Increases Sharp Eyes's duration.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes - Guardbreak
skills.description: Grants Sharp Eyes a bonus to Enemy DEF Ignored.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases the Critical Rate of Sharp Eyes.

skills.name: Arrow Stream - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Arrow Stream's damage.

skills.name: Arrow Stream - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Arrow Stream.

skills.name: Arrow Stream - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Arrow Stream's number of attacks.

skills.name: Hurricane - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage for Hurricane, Arrow Blaster, and installed Arrow Blaster.

skills.name: Hurricane - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Hurricane.

skills.name: Hurricane - Split Attack
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks. Reduces the damage of Hurricane.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes
skills.description: Temporarily grants party members the ability to locate an enemy's weak spot to deal fatal damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Arrow Stream
skills.description: Shoots a wild flurry of arrows straight ahead.

skills.name: Hurricane
skills.description: Launches a tremendous volley of arrows, like a catastrophic rainstorm. Holding the skill key will fire arrows continuously. You can also move while firing. Targets the enemy with the highest HP.\nCan use Quiver Cartridge during this skill.

skills.name: Gritty Gust
skills.description: Tear nearby enemies apart with a gust of wind. Also boosts Arrow Blaster and Arrow Blaster turrets.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.description: Steel yourself for battle to increase damage.

skills.name: Fury of the Wild
skills.description: Temporarily infuses Phoenix, Frostprey, and Shadow Raven with mysterious power for a devastating attack. Can only be used when either Phoenix, Frostprey, or Shadow Raven are summoned.
skills.note: Shared Bowman V skill (Skill/40000.img); also in the other Explorer Bowman folder.

skills.name: HEXA Hurricane
skills.description:
Launches a catastrophic swarm of arrows at tremendous speed. Targets the enemy with the highest Max HP.
Obtain a special arrowhead from the enemy every time the arrows hit. Once a certain number of special arrowheads are gathered, press Interact/Harvest during the skill to enter shootout mode, which fires even more arrows at once. Enter shootout mode automatically when you gather the max number of special arrowheads.
Shootout Mode can be canceled by pressing Interact/Harvest.
With Action Customization enabled, you can change modes by pressing the attack key, instead of Interact/Harvest.
Can move and use Quiver Cartridge while using this skill.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off

skills.name: HEXA Hurricane: Shootout Mode
skills.description:
You can fire even more arrows at once by using the special arrowheads. Shootout Mode can be canceled by pressing Interact/Harvest during the skill.
With Action Customization enabled, you can change modes by pressing the attack key, instead of Interact/Harvest.
Can move and use Quiver Cartridge while using the skill.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off

skills.name: HEXA Arrow Stream
skills.description:
Shoots a wild flurry of arrows straight ahead.
Periodically enhances to an enhanced Arrow Stream. The enhanced Arrow Stream fires even more arrows that strike further.
With Action Customization enabled, Enhanced Arrow Stream can only be triggered by holding up and using the skill.
Permanently increases Advanced Final Attack's damage.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off

skills.name: HEXA Arrow Blaster
skills.description:
Shoots an arrow at a high angle. If you press and hold the skill key, you will fire continuously. While firing, press Up or Down to control the force of the shot.
While casting the skill, press the Interact/Harvest key to set up an Arrow Blaster--which fires arrows automatically--at your location. With Action Customization enabled, you can set up the Arrow Blaster by pressing the attack key, instead of the Interact/Harvest key.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off.

skills.name: HEXA Quiver Cartridge
skills.description: Uses a special arrowhead. Reuse the skill to change the arrowhead you'll use.

skills.name: Extra Quiver Cartridge
skills.description:
Expands the Quiver Cartridge to load special arrowheads. Upon using arrows in the Quiver Cartridge, special arrowheads are additionally loaded to currently unused Quiver Cartridges.
If you use an Extra Quiver Cartridge, additional loaded special arrowheads are fired when direct skill attacks land.
In Auto Mode, the skill is used automatically when the quantity of loaded arrowheads in all cartridges exceeds a certain number.
Extra Quiver Cartridges can be used while skills are used, and special arrowheads can't be loaded while applied.
Special arrowheads are unaffected by attack reflection.
Toggle auto-use mode On/Off: Right-click

notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.
Job 301 is Pathfinder ("The Archer's Art"), not an Explorer Bowman line — out of scope for this branch; see the Pathfinder worker.
Job 300 ("Bowman Basics") skills are shared by the Bowmaster and Marksman lines and appear in both folders.
Guided Arrow, Vicious Shot and Fury of the Wild are shared Bowman 5th-job skills and appear in both the Bowmaster and Marksman folders.

Jobs 314/324 are the 6th-job (HEXA) skillbooks, not Hyper files: HEXA actives (HEXA Hurricane etc.) plus the 6th-job active skills (Bowmaster: Ascendant Shadow, Flashpoint; Marksman: Final Aim, Fatal Trigger).
Sol Janus / Sol Hecate (common 6th-job origin skills) were not located in Skill/40000.img or Skill/40003.img in GMS 270; same gap as Hero.
